title: A surprising vitamin A discovery is changing what scientists know about vision
caption:
For 30 years, we thought eye cells just shifted positions to create sharp vision. New research shows they actually transform their identity using vitamin A and hormones. This discovery could eventually help scientists restore sight.

Source: Sciencedaily - A surprising vitamin A discovery is changing what scientists know about vision

https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/10/261028234813.htm
